notes.title: Update 4.0 Out Now
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to share with you an update that's been in the works all year: 

[h2]Main Story[/h2]
This update marks the completion of the main story line. Not only does the game now have an ending, but the entire main story/objectives have been completely redone.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
Another addition to the game is Achievements. If you're casually or really into achievement collecting, this will really interest you.

[h2]Rain[/h2]
It now rains in Weed County.

[h2]Quest Menu[/h2]
Track all your deliveries and quests in one place within the Quest Menu.

[h2]The Handbook[/h2]
The handbook can be found in the menus. If you're stuck or want to learn how to do something in the game, the handbook will probably have the info you need.

[h2]Shorter Days[/h2]
Before every minute lasted 60 seconds. That's been cut in half to  30 seconds. This makes the day/night cycles faster, but still slow enough to get stuff done.


[h2]Respect Level Changes[/h2]
As you payoff your debt, your Respect level will increase. Initially, higher respect levels would unlock certain features in the game. I feel like this slowed down the game in unintentional ways. Now, unlocking higher Respect levels will give you perks and help you advance through the game rather than slow you down. This means all existing real estate, upgrades, jobs, deliveries, etc... are unlocked from the beginning.


[h2]Report Bugs![/h2]
If you find any bugs, please let me know! I try to fix them quickly when I hear about them or find them myself. You can let me know through email at unicorndengames@gmail.com or the Steam forums.


[h2]More To Come[/h2]
I have more to bring to Weed County that I'm excited to share with you soon. Follow me on Twitter to see current updates on what I'm working on!

notes.title: Update 0.0.3.0 Out Now
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

This update adds some new features to already existing features like automation and selling product. Deals have been added. When you talk to Darrell a new menu will open up and display the new deals that earn you a lot of dirty cash. Another addition that goes hand in hand with Deals is the new auto laundering system. With a minimum of $10,000 in dirty cash you can talk to Lance and have him launder some of you cash every day. FYI, Lance takes a 30% cut for himself.

Other than the bug fixes, those are the main new additions to Weed County. These changes require you to start a new game. If you have any comments or bugs that I missed, let me know in the forums or at unicorndengames@gmail.com.

notes.title: Update v0010 Out Now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

This update includes bug fixes for an issue involving using keyboard shortcuts to enter the menu system. I've rewritten it entirely so it's more efficient and straight forward on the back end. Just like before, you can enter the inventory menu by pressing "E" and go back to the game by pressing "E" again. Press "R" for the Respect menu, "M" for the Map, "J" for quests, and "ESC" for the Options menu.

This update adds an inventory button on the main GUI above the need bars in-game. By pressing the gears icon, you'll enter the Options menu just like before, and now with the new inventory button you can enter the inventory by pressing the backpack icon.

The next several updates will include bug fixes, polish, and balances. These next updates will help  solidify existing systems before moving on and adding more larger pieces of content.

If you experience any bugs or have any feedback, let me know at unicorndengames@gmail.com

notes.title: New Update V9 Out Now
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

After several months of working on the largest update Weed County has seen so far, I'm happy to say version 0009 is now available. 

This new update changes the game quite significantly gameplay-wise and there's also a lot of changes under the hood. Because of the extent of some of these additions and changes, any save older saves won't be compatible with this new update. The good news is that I've spent a lot of time future proofing the game so there shouldn't be save compatibility issues in the next several updates (at least).

Here’s a breakdown of all the additions and noteworthy changes in the new update. At the bottom is all the changes in bullet point form.


[h2]NEW DETAILS PANEL[/h2]
When you hover the mouse over an interactive object, a panel will pop up on the right side of the screen. This panel will tell you what the object is and details about it, like how to use it. This feature is helpful for many reasons as you can easily see prices at the thrift store or the growth time on your “crops” at home.


[h2]NEW REAL ESTATE[/h2]
As you walk around Weed County, you’ll notice more for sale signs next to buildings. You can now pretty much buy every property. Commercial properties will allow you to launder dirty cash. Residential properties can’t launder money but still generate rent. With all the new buyable properties, you can potentially generate a large sum of passive income.


[h2]RESOURCE GATHERING[/h2]
Around Weed County you might notice a new plant scattered around the area. By picking the fruit you’ll get Cactus Fruit. It’s a new natural resource that can be found and used to create a more specialized and valuable product. In future updates, more resources will be added that can be gathered and used for various recipes.


[h2]DELIVERIES[/h2]
A new way to make cash is through selling your product to people around town. Each person will request different products and different amounts. This is a great way to earn more cash because individuals will pay more for specialized deliveries than selling all your product to Darrell. These deliveries can be unlocked as you increase your respect level. You can see what the person is requesting by hovering the mouse over them and viewing the details popup. 


[h2]EDIBLES[/h2]
One of the delivery requests will be brownies. To bake edibles, you can buy a stove, buy ingredients at the gas station, and get cooking. Delivering brownies when requested can be quite lucrative. Currently the only way to sell edibles is through deliveries, but this will be expanded in the future.


[h2]CREATE NEW STRAINS[/h2]
A new workbench has been added where you can create new strains of weed. This workbench is available to buy at the blackmarket. By combining weed and other ingredients, you can create strains that will be more valuable than Weed alone. For example, you can currently create the Cactus Weed strain. By using the Cactus Fruit you gathered and weed, Cactus Weed will be created, which can be sold through deliveries for a high price. As more resources and ingredients are added to that game, more strains will be added as well.


[h2]NEW LOCATION - ABANDONED AUTO SHOP[/h2]
If you head West off the beaten path of Crossroads, you'll arrive at a new location. This is a purchasable property where you can not only launder cash but also automated weed growing. After buying the old auto shop, you'll have the option to buy up to nine planters that will automatically grow and harvest weed for you. This automation does come at a premium though but well worth it.


[h3]REPORTING BUGS[/h3]
Because there are so many changes and additions in this update, I expect to be spending some time fixing bugs that may have slipped through testing. Please report any bugs you encounter in the Steam Weed County discussion forums on the 'report bug' thread. You can also report bugs to unicorndengames@gmail.com. Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs or given feedback so far!

[/list]

notes.title: v0009 Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I've been busy planning what content will go into v0009 for Weed County and I've decided to put three planned updates into one larger update. There's a couple reasons why making a larger update makes sense. The main reason is because the game will feel disjointed if some of these new features exist without some of the other features. I think they complement each other and make the gameplay fuller. The other reason is because it will remove save incompatibilities in future updates. v0009 will definetly not be compatible with previous saved games, sadly. But, the incompatibilities mean big changes to the core gameplay. Here are some of the features coming in update v0009.


[h2]New Real Estate[/h2]
Pretty much everything will be purchasable by the player. Stores will allow the player to launder dirty cash and bring in some nice income. Residential homes will bring in income from rent. This is similar to how real estate works in the game currently, but there will be way more properties to buy. Over time, players will be able to earn substantial amounts of passive income from real estate as well as launder more dirty cash at a time.

[h2]Collecting Resources[/h2] 
There will be plants and other resources scattered around Weed County that can be gathered as ingredients for various "medicines".

[h2]New Products[/h2] 
You'll be able to collect resources and buy ingredients at the Gas Station to make new products like pot brownies. These products will vary in complexity and will be more valuable the more complex they are to make.

[h2]Deliveries[/h2] 
As your Respect level increases people around Weed County will start requesting some of your products. They pay premium price and is a great way to earn more dirty cash.

[h2]The Warehouse[/h2] 
Near your home will be a new location with an abandoned warehouse. You'll be able to buy the run down warehouse, purchase upgrades, and grow more weed. You'll also be able to hire help which will grow weed for you. In other areas of the warehouse you'll be able to mass produce dimebags, bricks, and other products to sell. This will be another great way to earn major amounts of dirty cash as you upgrade the warehouse.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2] 
There will also be more GUI improvements, bug fixes, and quality of life fixes. More details will be revealed when the update is released with the full patch notes.

notes.title: Update v0008 Out Now
notes.content:
Below is a more detailed explanation of what this update brings, but first here's the TL;DR changelog:

[list]
[*] Revamped look of main menu
[*] Revamped look of options menu
[*] Added map tab
[*] Added Inventory tab
[*] Added Respect tab
[*] Added Quests tab
[*] Added memories tab
[*] Added hide gui toggle 'F5' hotkey
[*] Revamped GUI
[*] Disabled furniture resetting while sleeping 
[/list]

[h2]THE MAP TAB[/h2]
Among the new menus added is the map menu. Press "M" to go straight to the map for fast access. Currently the map menu is blank and will include the map in a future update when the world is more built up. Until then, this menu is not much use but shows what content is coming soon to Weed County.

[h2]THE INVENTORY TAB[/h2]
Originally, there were only a few inventory items and all of them were displayed on the main gui. Since Weed County will be getting more ingredients, products, and ways to refine these products in the future, I needed to create an inventory menu where the player can view everything they are holding. The inventory comes already organized and will display all the items available in the game so the player will know what to work towards.

[h2]THE RESPECT TAB[/h2]
This menu existed before, but now has been completely redone. View your current respect level and whats been unlocked. You can also view what features get unlocked at higher levels, so you know what to work on next.

[h2]THE QUEST TAB[/h2]
This is another tab that is currently empty, but will provide information about quest progress. Instead of chatting with Nancy to see if her quest has reset, simply check the quest tab to see if her quest is available. As more quests are added, they will be shown here too.

[h2]THE MEMORIES TAB[/h2]
This tab is currently empty, but will have unlockable cutscenes that will tell the story of what happened before the main character lost his memory in the car accident. 

[h2]NEW GUI[/h2]
You'll probably notice the GUI has been polished and improved upon. The time of day has been moved center for easy viewing, the inventory has been moved to its own menu, and a gear icon button has been added for quick access to the options menu (pressing "ESC" will also take you there).

If you have any questions or experience new bugs with this update, let me know!

notes.title: v0008 - New GUI and Menus Coming Soon
notes.content:
Now that v0007 rolled out, it's a good time to talk about the next update 0008. I don't know the exact release date for this update, but it will probably roll out sooner than v7. This update focuses solely on the gui and menus. This update should have a faster turn around because I've been planning it for several months already.

[h2]NEW GUI[/h2]
Most, if not all, of the user interfaces will be redone and will be a big improvement. In a lot of ways, the new gui will be simplified and easier to read. It will also offer more room for additional buttons or readable stats in the future.


[h2]NEW MENUS[/h2]
Every menu will get refreshed, including the main menu. There will also be additional menus added for future features. Since this update focuses on the visual look of the menus, not the new features they will display, the new menus will be empty until I add to them in a future update. However, the new menus will show what's in store for future content.My goal is to get these new menus filled so they don't remain empty for very long.


[h2]WHEN?[/h2]
There's no specific release date for v8, but I would guess it'll be out within the next two weeks. I'll provide specific details of all the changes when it's released. See ya then!

notes.title: v0007 Update Out Now
notes.content:
Update 0.0.0.7 is rolling out now and includes a bunch of changes, specifically the addition of 7 new areas to visit. Here's a rundown of the update and a list below.


[h2]LOCATIONS[/h2]
The meat of this update focuses on the 7 locations added to Weed County. These areas include characters with new dialog as well. In future updates these locations will be given more purpose as the characters are given quests or the other areas are given more planned content. I plan to give every location a purpose, if they don't already.  Tony's bar has been added to an existing area, which adds a new bartending job.


[h2]RUN TOGGLE[/h2]
Not only has the walking speed been increased slightly, but I've also added a run toggle key. By default your character will walk, but by pressing the Shift key can run. Press the Shift key again to walk again. Walking is useful when the player is trying to move furniture around the house. It allows for more precise movement. Running will be useful for traveling from area to area. There is no stamina limiting the amount of time you can run, but I may make the energy need slightly lower quicker when running in the future. Generally, I don't want to punish the player for wanting to move quickly.


[h2]OPTIONS CHANGES[/h2]
Now when you change your settings in the main menu, a config file will be generated saving your settings. Those settings will be applied automatically at the startup of the main menu. Previously, saved option settings loaded only when a game was being loaded.

While in the pause menu, there is now a 'Show FPS' option. This will put the FPS counter at the bottom left of the screen allowing you to see how the game is performing on your system.



[h2]NEED FAILURE CHANGES[/h2]
Previously, when your character's needs went below zero you would some time to raise the need before passing out or getting arrested. Sadly, it was incredibly buggy and didn't work as intended. So, I reworked the way need failures occur. Now if a need is too low you won't be able to participate in an action that will lower that need further. For example, if your energy is very low, your character will be too tired to tend to the Weed. You'll have to sleep first to raise your energy before harvesting that Weed. This will also help players who may perform an activity, while not knowing needs are low resulting in a frustrating failure. Needs still decay over time and that may result in a need hitting zero. Now, if a need hits zero there is an instant failure notification.


[h2]INTERACTION HINTS[/h2]
Now when you approach an object if it highlights red, it can be interacted with. If there is no red highlight, it cannot be interacted with. I may expand or change this addition in the future.


[h2]CHANGE LOG[/h2]
Here's the full list of changes. If you have any questions tweet me at: [url=https://twitter.com/unicorndengames]https://twitter.com/unicorndengames[/url]

[list]
[*] Added 7 locations
[*] Added 5 characters
[*] Added Options config file loading at startup
[*] Increased walking speed
[*] Added run toggle
[*] Added FPS UI option
[*] Added Interaction hints
[*] Added need rejections
[*] Added instant need failures when need hits zero
[*] Decreased energy usage when making dimebags
[*] Decreased energy usage when using planters
[*] Fixed needs going negative
[*] Fixed Respect menu lighting bug
[*] Fixed Jim's dialog bug that changed the quest objective
[/list]

notes.title: Happy 4/20 Update
notes.content:
In celebration of 4/20 there's a new update out with a limited time event that will benefit your weed business greatly.

[h3]Last day for Discount[/h3]
Today is also the last day to get Weed County at the discounted launch price. It'll be awhile before it goes on sale again, and with the event going on, now's the best time to jump into Weed County.

notes.title: Weed County Roadmap Update #1
notes.content:
As the release date for Early Access approaches I thought it’d be a good time to talk about what’s coming in the first few updates. These posts will be regular and will keep you updated on the progress of upcoming changes to the game. I won’t address every hotfix update that may arise, as these post will be for larger updates.

Firstly, on April 20th there will be a small update for the celebration of 4/20. The small update may include initial bug fixes, but more importantly, it’ll add something to celebrate that momentous occasion. I’ll talk more about it when the time comes.

Secondly, the first large content update will come after 4/20. I don’t have a specific date for it yet, but as it nears completion I’ll be able to talk about specifics more. The meat of this update will include locations. More areas to explore, more people to meet, and more things to do will all be apart of this update. It will also become the foundation for future updates as more purchasable properties, more quests, and more jobs will be added to these locations in the future.

Another part of the update will include two new needs. Fun and Comfort. You’ll be able to buy furniture that will satisfy both those needs. Sitting on the couch will make your comfort rise, while sleeping on that terrible mattress will make your comfort lower. Tending to your “plants” will also lower your comfort. Watching TV will be a good way to raise your fun as well as doing other fun activities. It’s all pretty self explanatory, but the addition of these two needs will open up the incentive to upgrade your furniture to nicer things so needs will rise faster. It will also give more furniture purpose in your home. I plan to eventually give every piece of furniture in your home a purpose, whether it’s a potted plant or a couch.

Those are the big parts of the first content update. There will also be bug fixes and things like that. When we get closer to getting this update out the door, I’ll post a full list of all the changes and additions included with the update.

Remember, like every early access game, save data may not be compatible between updates. It depends on the kinds of things changed or added to the game. So, it’s always recommend to start a new game every now and then after a new update comes out so you can see the new content properly.


If you have any further questions send them my way on Twitter twitter.com/unicorndengames or here in on Steam in the discussion forums. See ya April 14th for the release of Weed County!
